title: Asian Garlic Green Beans

items.item: sesame seeds, chopped peanuts, or slivered almonds, for topping (optional)

instructions: Trim the ends off the green beans. Mince the garlic and chop the shallot.
Add the sesame oil to a large skillet over medium to medium-high heat. Let heat for a couple of minutes until hot.
Carefully add the shallot and garlic. Heat for 20-30 seconds.
Add the green beans and stir well to coat.
Sauté until just tender, about 5-6 minutes, stirring often so the garlic doesn't burn.
Add the teriyaki sauce. Toss to combine and cook 1-2 minutes.
When serving, don't forget the garlic/shallot pieces on the bottom of the pan — huge flavor!
